summary: Keep (City of North Battleford campground). City page unchanged: 61 sites (41 serviced, 20 non-serviced), many pull-through, C$22-38 2026 before tax, weekly/monthly rates, Campspot booking, May 15 - Sep 30. Not waterfront kept. Pin fine. Google 3.6 (89).
flags: GOOGLE: 'David Laird Campground' 3.6 (89 reviews). Local campground - no Google gate; reported for the reviewer.

Nightly share not measurable: www.campspot.com refuses plain HTTP (not retried); the 2026-10-13 capture found the Campspot park (4805) listing no site types on any date tried.
HOOKUPS: amperage is not posted on the city page; electric left unset.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept - the loops sit in fields; a small dugout pond lies ~100 m south of the loops behind a tree belt.
